entries.title: Flood Inundation Mapping and Evacuation Routing: An Approach for Flood Risk Management
entries.org: Final year project, IOE Thapathali Campus
items: Developed a hydrologic and hydraulic model and built 2D flood simulation models to analyze spatial flood extent and flow dynamics
Analyzed the critical infrastructure within the flood hazard zones
Proposed evacuation strategies based on flood depth and hazard zones

entries.title: Flood Hazard Mapping and Structural Design Recommendation
items: Conducted floodplain surveys along the Hanumante and Manohara river systems to support flood hazard mapping and hydraulic analysis
Applied the surveyed data to generate terrain for detailed analysis
Generated inundation maps and applied HEC-RAS and HEC-HMS for hydraulic and hydrologic simulation
Recommended both engineering and non-engineering measures for reducing flood vulnerability
